items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-06
items.q: I can remember Papa Celestine playing Hold That Tiger and how we danced well around.

ctx.x: Well, what about the friends of your parents? Did any of them say anything good in the music?

I don't remember many friends of my parents even discussing jazz to any extent. I know that we all liked Dixieland jazz when I started going to dances and things. You and your friends? Our friends. We all loved it. Oh, we liked Papa Celestine who was probably in his glory then and better then than he is even now. What about what did you say? Oh, well, I would say in about, oh, the late 20s and early 30s. I can remember Papa Celestine playing Hold That Tiger and how we danced well around. We didn't jitterbug in…
And then it was very popular with your set. Oh, oh, yes. How about what age?
